admission_invariants: Default Physics.get_state() with sig=None is a legacy compact state and is not accepted as complete branch-point state.
Only explicit mjSTATE_INTEGRATION at pinned numeric mask 32767 or Physics.copy(share_model=False) is accepted as physics snapshot type.
Python task, wrapper and driver/controller state are separate from MjData and must be captured and bound.
Task RandomState is required; if sensor noise is enabled, its independent MuJoCo RNG state is required separately.
Prefix state and observation maximum absolute error must each be <= 1e-9 before intervention.
Auxiliary rest/settling may only be present if part of the common factual prefix.
All sibling branches share the same snapshot, exogenous schedule, prefix trace and branch-point step.
Post-intervention trajectories may diverge or remain identical in a null case.

fixtures.purpose: Reject default compact Physics.get_state() as complete state.
Admit explicit 4.0.1 mjSTATE_INTEGRATION at 32767 with fresh-process prefix matches.
Reject a symbolic integration signature with a wrong numeric value.
Reject a plugin model whose snapshot omits plugin state.
Reject enabled MuJoCo sensor noise without a captured independent RNG state.
Reject a branch point whose dm_env wrapper will reset on the next step.
Reject wrapper step count that differs from the claimed branch-point tick.
Reject an auxiliary rest operation applied only to a branch.
Accept Physics.copy(share_model=False) with bound model and data digests.
Reject sibling branch with different exogenous schedule.
Allow post-intervention trajectories to differ after common complete reset.
Allow identical post-intervention trajectories for a valid null case.
